raw_html: [[Improved Paralyzing|Improved Paralyzing ]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Improved Paralyzing|Improved Paralyzing ]]:''' Any creature struck by this weapon must succeed on a DC 28 [[Will save]] or be paralyzed. The target may attempt a new save to end the effect every several seconds; otherwise the paralysis lasts for 1 minute.
